Privacy.metaDescription: How Baseline collects, uses, and protects personal data, the cookies we set, and the subprocessors we rely on.
Privacy.heading: Privacy & Cookie Notice
Privacy.whoBody: Baseline provides a platform for authoring rubrics and evaluating AI outputs. Baseline is the data controller for the personal data described here. Our governing law and place of establishment is <jur>[JURISDICTION]</jur>. If you have any questions or want to exercise your rights, contact us at <mail></mail>.
Privacy.collectAccount: Account data — your email, name, and organization memberships, so we can authenticate you and provide the service. Legal basis: performance of our contract with you.
Privacy.collectContent: Content you create — rubrics, datasets, evaluation runs, and related data you enter. Legal basis: performance of our contract with you.
Privacy.collectBilling: Billing data — subscription and payment identifiers, processed through Stripe. Legal basis: performance of our contract and compliance with legal obligations.
Privacy.collectAnalytics: Product analytics & error monitoring — usage events, device/browser information, and error reports. Legal basis: your consent, collected via the cookie banner. These are off until you accept, and you can withdraw consent at any time.
Privacy.retentionBody: We retain account and content data for as long as your account is active, and delete or anonymize it after you close your account, subject to any retention we must keep for legal, tax, or fraud-prevention reasons. Analytics data is retained according to each analytics provider's standard retention windows.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can access, correct, export, or erase your personal data. You can export your data or permanently delete your account at any time from <settings>Settings → Account</settings>. Depending on where you live, you may also have the right to restrict or object to processing, or to lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority. To make any other request, email <mail></mail>.
Privacy.cookiesIntro: We use a small number of cookies. Strictly-necessary cookies are required to run the service and are always active. Analytics cookies are only set after you accept them in the banner — you can decline without losing any functionality.
Privacy.cookiesManage: You can change your analytics choice at any time: <prefs>Manage cookie preferences</prefs>.

cookiePurpose.authToken: Keeps you signed in (Supabase authentication session).
cookiePurpose.activeOrg: Remembers which organization you're currently working in.
cookiePurpose.analyticsConsent: Remembers your cookie choice so we don't ask again.
cookiePurpose.posthog: PostHog product-analytics cookies — set only after you accept.

Privacy.subprocessorsIntro: We rely on the third-party services below to operate Baseline. Each processes personal data on our behalf under a data-processing agreement. The analytics subprocessors run only after you consent.
Privacy.transfersBody: Some of our subprocessors are located in the United States. Where personal data is transferred outside your region, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.
Privacy.changesBody: We may update this notice from time to time. When we make material changes, we'll update the "last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you in the app.
